given: a viewer reaching a Property without the analytics capability
then: says the capability is not entitled

given: a Property belonging to another Organization
then: the database returns no rows and isolates the tenant

given: a Property with no rooms or beds configured
then: a window of a Property that has never had a Stay says nothing happened and shows no occupancy: nothing happening is not zero percent (ANALYTICS-10)

given: a Property with inventory but no occupied stays in the window
then: a window with no occupied nights shows no ADR or RevPAR, a dash and never a zero (ANALYTICS-10)

given: a folio with room night charge and an exact reversal
then: reversals reduce gross revenue to net

given: a folio with a payment and an exact reversal
then: reversals reduce gross payments to net

given: payments posted across cash card bank transfer and other
then: amounts are aggregated by payment method

given: a viewer holding finance.manage_folio
then: full revenue ADR RevPAR and payments figures are displayed

given: a viewer lacking finance.manage_folio
then: occupancy figures are shown while revenue metrics are masked

given: a Property in a specific timezone
then: today is evaluated in the Property's own business date

given: range parameter set to 7d
then: window spans 7 business days ending today

given: range parameter set to 30d
then: window spans 30 business days ending today

given: range parameter set to mtd
then: window spans from first day of month to today. Amended: the mtd range now opens the current month (AN-S2-19), whose figures are the same but cover closed days only (AN-S2-04)

given: unknown range parameter in URL
then: defaults gracefully to 7d

given: a Staff Member reaching the Property
then: the window is the calendar month September 2026 in the Property's business calendar; previous and next move one month; with no month given the current month is shown

given: ?month=abc, ?month=2026-13 or a month after the current one
then: the current month is shown, with no error page

given: a month earlier than the Property's first Stay or Folio line
then: the screen says there was no activity that month and shows no percentages, ADR or RevPAR: nothing happened is not zero percent

given: the current month with N of M business days closed
then: the screen says month to date and names N of M, where M is the days since the Property had a unit; revenue and the rates that divide it cover the closed days only, and occupancy covers every day so far (ANALYTICS-01)
test_name: tests/unit/month-report.test.tsx: says month to date, and how many days have closed, in an open month

given: today's Stays are in house and the day has not closed so its room nights are not yet charged
then: today is a row marked open: its night counts in occupancy, which needs no charge, and in no revenue, ADR or RevPAR, which would pair a night with no charge. Tonight's figure is the one Today shows

given: a month with a prior month that has activity
then: each headline shows the prior month's figure and the change, occupancy in points and money in percent; an open month is compared with the same number of elapsed days of the prior month

situation: prior month has nothing to compare
given: a prior month with no activity or a zero figure
then: the change reads as a dash, never infinity or a made-up percentage

given: a unit created on the 20th of a 30 day month
then: the unit counts from the day it was created: available nights are summed per day, not today's unit count times the days

given: a room night of August reversed in September
then: August shows room revenue gross, corrections and net with the correction on the night's own date; September shows nothing for it; the screen says the month is as of today

given: an incidental charge and its reversal
then: other revenue is dated by the Property's business date when the line was posted, a reversal by its own posting date, and the figure is net

given: a Property in UTC+3 with the default 04:00 cutoff, a line posted at 01:00 on the 1st and another at 05:00 on the 1st
then: the 01:00 line belongs to the last business day of the previous month and the 05:00 line to the 1st: the Property is still working the earlier day until its cutoff

situation: the one way a business date is computed
given: any folio line without a stored business date
then: it uses app.business_date(posted_at, the Property's zone, its cutoff) and nothing else, because that function is the only place a business date is computed (ADR 0021); posted_at cast to a date is never used

given: a payment of 100.00 recorded and a second of 40.00 reversed
then: money collected reads positive, net of the reversal, by method, each dated by the day it was posted

given: a month with days of no activity
then: every day of the month has a row, with weekday, occupied nights, occupancy and room revenue, and the rows sum to the headline

situation: money masked in every new surface
given: a viewer lacking finance.manage_folio
when: viewing unit type rows, corrections, payments and comparison
then: revenue and payment fields are null in the response for each; nights and occupancy remain

given: a Property the viewer does not reach, or another Organization's
then: the query returns nothing and the screen shows its not-found state, not an empty month

given: a Property without the analytics capability
when: requesting the screen or a month
then: the rail has no entry and the route and query both refuse

given: a night charged while the report is being assembled
then: every figure comes from one snapshot, so the headline equals the table and the table equals the breakdown

given: a bookmarked ?range=mtd
then: it shows the current month, which is the same figure; today, 7d and 30d remain as trailing windows

given: any month with a charged night
then: each headline shows the division it is, with its two figures, so a reader can check it by hand

given: no activity, loading, refused, every locale including Arabic
then: each has its own state; layout mirrors in Arabic using logical utilities; numerals and currency follow the locale; month names come from the locale

given: a Property whose first Folio fixed its currency (ADR 0036)
then: every amount is in that currency and none is converted or summed across currencies

given: a Property with Resident Stays and Guest Stays
then: occupancy counts both and splits the nights by type; ADR divides room revenue by charged Guest nights only, so Resident nights do not dilute it; a Property of Residents shows low revenue because Residents are billed monthly and that billing is deferred (RT-S3-05)

given: room and other revenue booked and payments collected in the month
when: viewing the month as a finance reader
then: one line shows revenue booked, money collected and the difference, named plainly as the change in what Guests owe; it does not claim to be a receivables report

given: an occupied night with no room night charge: a Resident Stay, a booking taken unpriced, or a Property without billing
then: the count of such nights is shown with its reason, to every reader, because it is operational: Resident Stay (billed monthly, deferred), booking taken unpriced, or Property without billing; amounts are never shown

given: units of more than one unit type
then: one row per unit type with nights, occupancy, room revenue and ADR; the rows sum to the headline and a test asserts it

situation: a unit's type after its nights are charged
given: a unit with charged nights
when: its type is read for the breakdown
then: a night is shown under its unit's type, which never changes: ranza_app is granted update on status, status_reason and updated_at only, so the unit type is fixed once created (ADR 0038 prices by it)

given: a day in the table
then: the Stays that held units that night with unit and nightly charge or the reason there was none, and the corrections posted that day; the counts equal the day's table row

given: a viewer lacking the permission
then: Stays and units show, charges are absent from the response rather than hidden by the screen

situation: day detail and the month change
given: a day's detail is open
when: closing it, opening another day, or selecting another month
then: closing returns focus to the day's row, another day replaces the detail, and a different month closes it; no detail from one month is ever shown under another

given: a payment is stored negative (folio credit) and its reversal positive
when: the screen sums them as stored
then: today the figure reads negative; the row AN-S2-13 says positive. Inferred from the check constraint and the query, not yet run. Resolved in AN-S2-13 in tests/integration/analytics.test.ts; reproduced red first as -19000 where 14000 was collected

situation: dating of other revenue and payments
given: a line without a business date
then: today it casts posted_at to a date in the database session's timezone: that ignores both the Property's zone and its cutoff, and room revenue uses business_date so the figures disagree after midnight. Read from the query, not yet run; the correct date is app.business_date (AN-S2-12). Resolved in AN-S2-11 and AN-S2-12; reproduced red first (a 03:30 line from the day before the window was counted)

given: a unit created partway through the window
then: today it multiplies the current unit count by the days in the window. Resolved in AN-S2-08; reproduced red first as 14 available nights where 9 were right

given: a Stay in house on a day not yet closed
then: today it counts tonight as occupied but its room night is charged at close, so ADR and RevPAR fall until the close runs. Resolved in AN-S2-05; reproduced red first as 5 occupied nights where 4 closed ones counted

given: a room night reversed after its night
then: today it dates the reversal by its own posting date, so a correction moves the month it was made in, not the month it corrects. Resolved in AN-S2-09; reproduced red first as 32000 where 42000 was right

given: the AN-S1 rows and their tests
when: a reader trusts a green run
then: tests/unit/analytics.test.ts restates the formulas inline and never calls getPropertyAnalytics, so no AN-S1 row except range parsing has a test that could fail; they are replaced by integration tests that call the query. Resolved in tests/integration/analytics.test.ts now calls the query for every AN-S1 row but range parsing, which stays a pure unit test

given: charges of several kinds
then: deferred: a folio line has a description and no category, and a charge catalogue is not built (blueprint 13); other revenue is one figure with its lines one drill-down away

given: a Property with 13 months of history
then: deferred: needs a year of data to be worth the space; the prior month answers the question first

given: a month on screen
then: deferred: the brief is to explain a month without exporting; export stays under blueprint 5.14 deferrals

given: a future month with confirmed Reservations
then: deferred: a forecast reads Reservations not Stays and is its own slice; a future month falls back to the current one (AN-S2-02)

given: an Organization with more than one Property
then: deferred: cross-Property comparison needs governed metrics across Properties (blueprint story 20)

given: a unit held out of order for part of a month
then: deferred: maintenance_unit_holds keeps one row per request and overwrites since when a request holds again, so the intervals are lost and a line built from it would be wrong; needs hold intervals recorded first. Until then a unit out of order stays in available nights and RevPAR says it is on total inventory

situation: out-of-order treatment as a Property setting
given: a Property that wants out-of-order nights removed from available nights
then: deferred: configurable treatment costs a new setting, and it depends on AN-DEF-06

situation: A month explained through the screen
given: a Property whose February and January are known to the unit: nights on three units, room night charges, a correction, other charges, payments by method and a Resident Stay
then: every headline figure, revenue and collection line, night count, unit type row and day row equals that history; the day rows add up to the headline; the comparison names January and its figures
test_name: a settled month is explained to the unit: every figure equals the history behind it

situation: Stepping back to the first month
given: January, the first month in which anybody stayed
when: the previous month control is pressed from February
then: January shows its own figures and says December 2025 had no activity, so there is nothing to compare with; no percentage is invented against December
test_name: the month before it compares against January, and January has no earlier month

situation: An open month in the browser
given: the current month, with every day before today closed and one Guest night on the 1st, beside a month before it with a night on the 1st and one on the 28th
then: it says month to date and how many of the days so far have closed, today is the open day and carries its occupancy and no revenue, days to come carry none, and the comparison uses the same elapsed days of the month before
test_name: an open month says month to date, counts closed days only, and compares the same elapsed days

situation: A month before any Stay in the browser
given: a month that ends before the Property's first Stay
then: the screen says nothing happened that month, with no figure card and no day table: nothing happening is not zero percent
test_name: a month before the Property had any Stay says nothing happened, not zero percent

situation: A reader without finance.manage_folio in the browser
given: a Staff Member holding the Housekeeping role, reaching the Property
when: they open a month and one of its days
then: occupancy and every night count show; no money appears anywhere on the month or the day, and one sentence says why
test_name: a reader without finance.manage_folio sees the nights and no money anywhere

situation: A Property that has not bought analytics
given: a Staff Member of a Property without the analytics capability
when: they look at the rail and type the address
then: the rail offers no Analytics and the address says the module is not in the Subscription, with no figure
test_name: a Property that has not bought analytics is not offered and its address refuses

situation: A Property the viewer is not assigned to
given: a Manager of one Property and the address of another Property of the same Organization
when: the Manager opens the other Property's month, and is later assigned to it
then: the first answer is the not-available state and not an empty month; once assigned, the same address shows the month
test_name: a Property the viewer is not assigned to is not shown, and the one they are assigned to is

situation: The month in Arabic in the browser
given: the same settled month, read in Arabic
then: the page is right to left, labels are Arabic, every figure and currency is the one the English page shows, and the day table starts at the right edge
test_name: the month in Arabic reads right to left, with its figures and currency intact

given: a month with nights slept on days no close has reached
then: occupancy and the nights behind it count every day that has happened, closed or not; revenue, ADR, RevPAR and the nights they divide by count the closed days only, and each figure's arithmetic line says which (ANALYTICS-01, ANALYTICS-06)

situation: The month table's open day is Today's number
given: a Property with rooms blocked and out of order tonight, an overdue Guest and a Guest in house
when: the month table's row for today and Today's occupancy are read
then: both count the same rooms of the same rooms: available is the rooms that can be let, in house is the Guests in them, and the percentage is the same (RANZ-52)
test_name: tests/integration/today-ux.test.ts: tonight_is_one_number_in_the_month_table_too: the table's open day is Today's occupancy

given: a room blocked or out of order with nobody in it, and one blocked with a Guest in house
when: tonight and a past day are read
then: tonight the first is not available and the second still is, because the Guest holds it; a past day keeps every unit it then had, because nothing records a block on a past date

situation: A month that is over with days never closed
given: a month whose later days no close reached, in a Property that had a unit only from the 3rd
then: it says incomplete and how many of the days since the Property had a unit were never closed; the days before it had a unit read before opening and carry no figure; the sentence about today is only in the current month (ANALYTICS-03)

given: a Property whose last close was some days ago, or has none
when: a month in progress or a window is read
then: it names the days waiting, counted as Close the day counts them, with a link to Close the day for a viewer who may close and a sentence saying who closes them for one who may not; a month that is over does not say it (ANALYTICS-04)

situation: Money before any day has closed
given: a period in which no day has closed
when: its headline and revenue sections are read
then: revenue, ADR, RevPAR, payments and what Guests owe are dashes with one sentence saying no day has closed, never TRY 0.00; occupancy still shows (ANALYTICS-02, ANALYTICS-04)

given: closed days with Guest nights and no room night charge, or only some nights charged
when: revenue and the rates are read
then: with none charged the room revenue and RevPAR are a dash that says how many occupied nights have no charge; with some charged each figure that rests on charges says how many nights earned none, so it is understated, and links to the Nights with no charge section (ANALYTICS-02)

situation: What there is to compare with
given: a month whose prior had no activity, a month with no closed day yet, and the first month of the Property
when: the comparison and the arrows are read
then: no activity says which month had none; a month with no closed day still compares occupancy over the days so far and shows revenue changes as dashes; the previous arrow is disabled for a month the Property did not exist in (ANALYTICS-05)

situation: A window is a month with another span
given: today, the last 7 days and the last 30 days
then: it is the month's headline, sections, words and rules over a trailing span, with no prior to compare with and no month to step to; a window's row for a day is the month's row for it; nobody sees the old window's Units, Sellable or Revenue Per Available Room wording (ANALYTICS-09, ANALYTICS-10)

situation: What a reader without money is told
given: a viewer without finance.manage_folio
when: the month or a window is opened
then: one sentence says revenue figures are shown only to staff who manage money and to ask the manager, with no permission key; the notes that say what revenue covers are not shown to them (ANALYTICS-08)
test_name: tests/unit/month-report.test.tsx: never names a permission key, and says who to ask

situation: A day is a row to open
given: the day table at any width
when: a day that has happened is pointed at, pressed or focused
then: the whole row opens the day, the date inside it is the link for a keyboard and a screen reader and its accessible name starts with the date the eye reads, and a chevron marks it; a day to come has none of these (ANALYTICS-12)
test_name: tests/unit/month-report.test.tsx: gives the date link a name that contains the date the eye reads

situation: A Stay in a day opens its booking
given: a day opened from the table, and a viewer who does or does not reach Reservations
then: each Stay that came from a booking links to it at the Reservations screen with its reference, for a viewer who reaches it only; a Stay with no booking has no link; the Nights with no charge section says to open a day and then the booking to add its price (ANALYTICS-11)

situation: A phone reads the headline first
given: the month at 375 pixels
then: the three headline figures are in view together before any note, the notes follow them, and the day table opens behind a button that says how many days it holds (ANALYTICS-14)

situation: Unit type rows follow the headline
given: a period whose revenue is a dash
when: the unit type rows are read
then: their revenue columns are dashes too, and while no day has closed they carry no money at all, so a row never says TRY 0.00 where the headline says it cannot be known (ANALYTICS-02)
test_name: tests/unit/month-report.test.tsx: shows the unit type rows' revenue as a dash too when no night has a charge

given: English writes TRY 0.00, Turkish ₺0,00 and Arabic 0.00 TRY
then: deferred: the convention is one decision in the shared formatter for every screen of the product, so it is the owner's to choose once and not a figure on this screen to change (ANALYTICS-13, FIN-12)

given: Front Desk holds finance.manage_folio, which also gates the revenue figures
when: the month is opened by a clerk
then: deferred: whether a clerk should read the Property's revenue is the owner's decision (RANZ-56); the gate is unchanged here (ANALYTICS-07)
